applies_when: prompt is a quadratic with no constant term, e.g. x² - 7x = 0

dbe_source.recommendation: Some candidates divided throughout by x, reducing a quadratic equation to a linear one and losing a root. Never divide an equation through by the variable. Factorise instead.

lesson.concept: When an equation has an x in every term, do not divide by x. Factorise x out instead. Dividing by x throws away the root x = 0.
lesson.why: Every quadratic has two roots. If you divide by x, you only find one of them. The other root is x = 0, and it disappears the moment you divide.

work: Do not divide by x. Factorise instead.
Set each factor to zero:  x = 0  or  x - 7 = 0

probe.hint: Factorise x out. Do not divide.

learner_message: You divided through by x, which throws away the root x = 0. Factorise instead.
